evals.prompt: 我有一个 Windows Python Telegram-Codex 桥接项目，当前需要 .env、两个 BAT 和手动安装依赖。请把它整理成新用户只编辑一个 BAT 顶部的 TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN 和 ALLOWED_USER_ID，然后双击即可启动，并保留现有 Codex 桌面会话。
evals.expected_output: A plan or implementation that has one public BAT, no additional manual configuration, automatic checks, path-independent startup, token redaction, and the existing desktop-session transport preserved.

evals.prompt: 现有桥接可以转发纯文字，但图片加文字会被忽略；它还用 codex exec resume 导致电脑桌面会话写入锁冲突。请修复成 Telegram 只做转发、消息进入正在运行的 Codex 桌面原对话，并要求最终仍只有一个 BAT 给新用户使用。
evals.expected_output: A fix that uses the desktop local app-tools interface, handles Telegram photo plus caption messages, keeps the selected session and history, prevents duplicate polling, and documents one-BAT deployment.

evals.prompt: 请检查一个复制到 D:\项目\我的桥接\ 的 Codex Telegram 项目是否满足最终交付：用户只改 BAT 中两个变量，路径换到别的盘符仍能启动，日志不泄露 Token，启动时能验证 Telegram Bot 和 Codex 接口，已有服务不会启动第二个实例。
evals.expected_output: A concrete acceptance review with path, credential, health-check, and single-instance findings, plus only actionable changes needed to meet the single-BAT contract.

evals.prompt: 我只改了单文件 BAT 的 Token 和用户 ID。Codex 正在运行，能找到 codex-app-tools 管道，但启动报找不到桌面接口。只读探测实际返回 -32602 Invalid app tool request；传入已有会话 ID 后 list_threads 成功。请修复并更新 skill，不要增加第三个配置，也不要改变 Telegram 原来的绑定。
evals.expected_output: Resolve a valid existing local caller thread automatically before starting the helper; keep caller context separate from the selected target; retain the actual JSON-RPC error; re-embed the fix and refresh the skill's sanitized BAT asset; distinguish list access from full forwarding validation.

evals.prompt: 新电脑第一次打开 Codex，状态库没有任何已有对话。桥接健康检查失败。请按 YanCodexChat 的单 BAT 要求处理，并说明状态库没有预期时间字段时怎么处理。
evals.expected_output: Inspect available schema fields and diagnose an absent conversation or incompatible schema precisely; instruct the user to create a desktop conversation and retry when none exists; do not silently create a separate chat, hardcode a developer session, or require another BAT setting.

evals.prompt: 修好了 runtime 里的 Python，文档也写了已修复；现在帮我发布新的 YanCodexChat skill，注意旧 skill 内嵌 BAT 还没有更新。模拟启动通过，真实 list_threads 通过，但 Telegram 完整收发还没做。
evals.expected_output: Regenerate the BAT's embedded payload, package the same credential-free BAT inside the skill, check decoded payload and packaged/public byte equality, and report full Telegram round-trip as unverified rather than claiming full success.

evals.prompt: 电脑 Codex 有六选项的问题卡，Telegram 只收到已发出选择题的文字，没有按钮。请支持选项点击、自己输入和跳过，并让回答进入电脑端原问题。不要用远程点击，更新单 BAT 和同版 skill。
evals.expected_output: Recover original async question IDs from the rollout, render compact Telegram buttons and free-text/skip, deliver one native user input through the desktop owner, keep polling responsive, re-embed and package the same sanitized BAT, and distinguish live discovery/rendering from human-selected round-trip completion.

evals.prompt: 我点了机器人旧问题的按钮，当时已经切换到另一个会话；另一个按钮点了两次。还有一次回答刚发送就断线重启了。请检查不能误发、重复提交或自动重放。电脑端已回答的问题也应该失效。
evals.expected_output: Check chat/user/session/active binding and original question freshness before dispatch; reject repeat and desktop-answered callbacks; persist question state; never retry or replay an uncertain write; prevent duplicate final replies when an active turn is steered.
